# Script to plot the relationship between avian Z chromosome sizes and the indentification of neo-sex chromosomes

## 1. read Z sizes file

```{r}
df_Z <- read.delim("C:/Users/Julia/Downloads/Z_sizes_sorted.txt")

#filtering to remove duplicates from multiple assemblies
#first, filter inversily by size
df_Z_sorted <- df_Z[order(df_Z$Species, -df_Z$Size), ]
#then keep only first occurrence of each species

df_Z_unique <- df_Z_sorted[!duplicated(df_Z_sorted$Species), ]
df_Z_90mb <- df_Z_unique [df_Z_unique$Size > 90000000,]
df_Z_85mb <- df_Z_unique [df_Z_unique$Size > 85000000,]



#get average size from avian Z chromosomes 

mean_Z <- mean(df_Z_unique$Size)

```

## 2. select species with identified sex chromosome fusions

```{r}

#define sex_fusions vector
sex_fusions <- c("Agapornis fischeri", "Podargus strigoides", "Poecile atricapillus", "Dryobates pubescens", "Amazona ochrocephala", "Agapornis roseicollis", "Pogoniulus pusillus", "Myzomela cardinalis", "Myzomela tristrami", "Ara ararauna", "Guaruba guarouba", "Amazona aestiva", "Myiopsitta monachus", "Psittacula echo", "Melopsittacus undulatus", "Prinia subflava", "Strigops habroptila", "Nyctibius grandis", "	
Nipponia nippon", "Acrocephalus paludicola", "Hirundo rustica", "Nipponia nippon", "Anser cygnoides", "Ara ararauna", "	
Dryobates pubescens", "Guaruba guarouba", "Harpia harpyja", "	
Picus viridis", "Poecile atricapillus", "Hirundo rustica", "Anser cygnoides")
```

## 3. plot bar plot of Species X Z size

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

df_plot <- df_Z_90mb %>%
  mutate(
    Size_Mb = Size / 1e6,
    Highlight = ifelse(Species %in% sex_fusions, "sex_fusions", "Other"),
    # Reorder Species factor levels by Size for a clean sorted plot
    Species = reorder(Species, Size_Mb)
  )

p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Size_Mb, y = Species, fill = Highlight)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(10, 180, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, max(df_plot$Size_Mb) * 1.05), # Ensures all bars fit neatly
    expand = c(0, 0)
    )+
  # Single scale_fill_manual call containing values, labels, and title
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "",
  breaks = c("sex_fusions"), # Keeps only 'sex_fusions' in the legend
  values = c("sex_fusions" = "#D55E00", "Other" = "grey80"),
  labels = c("sex_fusions" = "described neo-sex chromosomes")
) +
  labs(
    x = "Z Chromosome Size (Mb)",
    y = NULL
    # Removed fill = NULL here so it doesn't overwrite 'name' from scale_fill_manual
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dotted")
  )

print(p)


ggsave("C:/Users/Julia/Downloads/Avian_Z_Sizes_complete.png", plot = p, width = 7, height = 11, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
#with legend

library(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(df_plot_reduced, aes(x = Size_Mb, y = Species, fill = Highlight)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  
  # Vertical reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 87, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Text anchored to top species bar, sitting cleanly right above it
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = 87, 
    y = "Podargus strigoides", # Anchors strictly to top species name
    label = "Mean Avian Z (87 Mb)", 
    vjust = -0.7,              # Pushes text right above top bar
    hjust = 0.5, 
    size = 3.2, 
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +

  # Prevents top plot clipping
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(10, 180, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, max(df_plot_reduced$Size_Mb) * 1.05),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "",
    breaks = c("sex_fusions"),
    values = c("sex_fusions" = "#D55E00", "Other" = "grey80"),
    labels = c("sex_fusions" = "described neo-sex chromosomes")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Z Chromosome Size (Mb)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dotted"),
    # Adds padding to top margin so unclipped text renders with margin space
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 5, l = 5, unit = "pt")
  )

print(p)
ggsave("C:/Users/Julia/Downloads/Avian_Z_Sizes_reduced_mean.png", plot = p, dpi = 300)

```
